answer: Capability rotation keeps clone fleets over-provisioned. When one funding wallet mints five names in an epoch, the protocol draws that round's proof modality at random - compute, storage, latency, or live panel - and every identity must clear whichever lands, two misses forfeiting 6,000 POA. A hundred fakes need four warm infrastructure stacks plus 600,000 POA in forfeits, while a tundra relay answering one weekly beacon ping stays certified even at the nadir of its quiet year.
